Located on Sigdon Road, this bright and well-maintained two double-bedroom flat offers comfortable living in one of Hackney’s most sought-after spots.

The property features a spacious living room, a separate kitchen, a modern bathroom, and a private balcony overlooking the peaceful communal garden. Natural light flows throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Just a four-minute walk to Hackney Downs Overground Station, you’ll enjoy fast connections to Liverpool Street, Hackney Central, and across the East and West London Overground lines. You’re also perfectly positioned between Hackney Downs and London Fields – ideal for weekend strolls or summer picnics.

The neighbourhood is brimming with local favourites, including Wilton Way, Whisper Stow, Binch, Casa Fofo, and Good Earth Coffee – all just a short walk from your front door.

This is a consistently popular property that always lets quickly – don’t miss out.
